teacher.title: Teacher Dashboard
teacher.createCourseFirst: Create a course first — problems belong to a course.
teacher.checkerLabel: How should the output be judged?

checkerHelp.exact: Output must match character for character. Pick another option if the answer involves decimals or has no fixed order.
checkerHelp.float: Numbers are compared numerically, so 0.30000000000000004 counts as 0.3.
checkerHelp.regex: The expected output of each test case is treated as a regular expression the whole output must match.
checkerHelp.other: Whitespace and ordering differences are ignored where the option says so.

teacher.lastTestCase: A problem needs at least one test case, or it can never be graded.
teacher.randomisePool: Give each student a random subset of these problems
teacher.randomiseHelp: Each student is dealt {perStudent} of the {total} selected problems, at random, the first time they open the exam. The deal is recorded so a reload shows the same paper.

dashboard.title: Problems
dashboard.empty: No problems in this category yet.

similarity.title: Similarity Report
similarity.disclaimerBefore: This is a screening tool, not a verdict. Short exercises often have only one or two reasonable solutions, so some baseline similarity across the whole class is normal and expected. A pair is only flagged as
similarity.disclaimerAfter: when it sits well above what the rest of the class produced on its own — always review the highlighted code yourself before drawing any conclusion.
similarity.notEnough: Not enough submissions in the same language yet to compare.
similarity.archiveNote: Screened against {size} archived submissions. Only pairs at or above {threshold}% of both submissions are listed — the archive has no class baseline to calibrate against, so the bar is deliberately high.
similarity.archiveNoMatches: No submission resembles an archived one closely enough to list.

examAdmin.accommodationsHelp: Minutes added to this student's deadline for this exam only. 0 removes the grant. The countdown, the submission window and the integrity logging all follow the extended deadline.
examAdmin.gradesHelp: An override replaces the automatic mark for one student on one problem. The automatic result is kept and shown beside it.
examAdmin.assignmentsHelp: This exam deals {count} problems per student at random. Kept so a paper can be audited if a student questions theirs.
examAdmin.noAssignments: Nobody has opened this exam yet, so nothing has been dealt.

archive.title: Screening archive
archive.subtitle: Finished cohorts kept for comparison against future ones.
archive.explainer: Screening a class against itself cannot see a solution handed down from a previous year — that answer looks unremarkable next to this year's classmates. Archiving a finished course keeps its submissions so the next cohort can be checked against it. The archive is yours alone and is never shown to students.
archive.empty: Nothing archived yet. Archive a finished course from the Courses page.
archive.confirmDelete: Delete “{label}” and its {count} archived submissions? Future screening will no longer compare against it.
